values.note: 26 campsites plus one double site, including 4 pull-throughs, a bicycle site and a horse site (both held for those users until 6 pm, then first-come), and one accessible site with an electric hookup (amperage not stated). Paved asphalt.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/charles-waters-campground ('paved asphalt with 26 campsites plus one double site, including 4 pull-through, one bicycle site, and one horse site; there is also one accessible site with electric hook-up', 'can accommodate RV's or trailers to 70 feet'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/charles-waters-campground ('The campground also has water; accessible vault toilets', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Larry Creek Group site is reservable on Recreation.gov. All other sites first come first serve.' Camping limited to 16 consecutive days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/charles-waters-campground (Reservations: 'Larry Creek Group site is reservable on Recreation.gov . All other sites first come first serve.'; 'Camping limited to 16 consecutive days.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF, Bass Creek Recreation Area, ~2 mi up Bass Creek Road off US-93 north of Stevensville; open meadow, nature and fire-ecology trails, trailheads into the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness. The nearby Larry Creek group site is reservable via recreation.gov. Campground host Memorial Day-Labor Day. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms 26 sites + a double (27), 4 pull-throughs, RVs/trailers to 70 ft, all family sites first-come. Added $15 (+$5 extra vehicle; was only inherited currency), season May-October, water and vault toilets, 16-night limit. One accessible site has electric but no amperage is given, so hookups left unrecorded. Note trimmed of restated values.
